_comment: Zone 1 farmland flavour NPC (content-npcs.md), and ⭐ THE FIRST NPC IN THE GAME THAT WALKS. Every conversant before him authors speed 0 under D4 (an NPC is an actor that authors no movement) — but D4's point was that an NPC is an ordinary actor rather than a kind of its own, so `content can later give one a loadout and a walk without changing what it IS` (role_content_test). This is that content: speed 0.7 and a 10-waypoint boustrophedon route at idleSpeedFactor 0.2, so he works the field in parallel rows instead of standing in it. ⚑ THAT is why aggroRadius 3 rather than the standing 1.0: senseRadius is max(aggro, interaction.range), and a man crossing a field should notice you before you are close enough to talk. Otherwise the usual unattackable shape — faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it), collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) and deliberately NOT Action(2) so no aura on either side can target it, mask 16 = Border only so nothing pushes it, xpFactor 0 to keep it off both the XP path and the nameplate. ⭐ ONE ROOT NODE AND NO OPTIONS, deliberately: the Farmer on the same field already carries two quests and a teaching, so a second giver here would be noise. He is there so the farm reads as WORKED rather than staffed by exactly one man — the baabara.json / forest-sign.json terminal-node shape. ⛑ entityType Farmer is a DELIBERATE REUSE and placeholder art (the standing call, as for the Shepherd and the Miller): a bespoke farmhand costs a wire enum value that can never be reclaimed plus an exhaustive client Record entry. He earns his own sprite at the Zone 1 art pass. ⚑ TEXT is plain (PO 2026-08-02): no lore or stylized wording yet. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Farmhand

lines: I do the work the farmer has no hands left for.
